basis.governing_question: Which ERP should replace the finance, purchasing and inventory systems, and how is it migrated and rolled out to 40 pharmacies and 2 warehouses?

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Establish business requirements and process fit-gaps for finance, purchasing and inventory across 40 pharmacies and 2 warehouses.

gate.label: Requirements sign-off
gate.decision: Go or no-go on starting vendor selection against the agreed requirements?

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Shortlist and score ERP vendors, and build the business case and rollout and migration plan for the selection decision.

gate.label: Selection decision
gate.decision: Which ERP vendor and rollout plan go forward into implementation?

phases.name: Implementation
phases.objective_one_line: Migrate data and roll out the selected ERP to 40 pharmacies and 2 warehouses for finance, purchasing and inventory.

gate.label: Final acceptance
gate.decision: Approve the ERP as running in all 40 pharmacies and both warehouses?

architect_notes: Engagement length is not given: 32 to 38 weeks is an estimate based on archetype ranges, 40 pharmacies, 2 warehouses and data migration.
Implementation added to the archetype's Diagnostic and Design because the brief covers migration and rollout; the archetype gives it no length.
